content.title: Adjuvant Chemotherapy: AC-T Regimen Cycle 3
content.rawText: Patient presented for Cycle 3 of AC chemotherapy (Doxorubicin 60 mg/m2 + Cyclophosphamide 600 mg/m2). Performance status ECOG 1. Mild nausea controlled with Aprepitant. No mucositis, neuropathy, or chest discomfort. Chemotherapy infused without acute hypersensitivity.

sections.clinicalSummary: Completed Cycle 3 AC Chemotherapy for breast carcinoma. Good tolerance, ECOG 1.
sections.impression: Completed Cycle 3 AC Chemotherapy for breast carcinoma. Good tolerance, ECOG 1.
